post.description: Create a new user account. Sends OTP to email for verification. No access token is returned until email is verified.

201.description: User created successfully. OTP sent to email.

post.summary: Verify email with verification token and OTP
post.description: Verify user email using a short-lived verification token issued at registration together with the OTP code sent by email. Sets access and refresh cookies on success.

401.description: Invalid or expired verification token or OTP

post.description: Resend OTP code to user email using an existing verification token.
Authenticate user with email and password. Sets access and refresh cookies.
Rotate refresh token and issue a new access token using refresh token cookie

get.description: Get authenticated user's profile from access token cookie; auto-rotates refresh token if access token expired

post.description: Initiate password reset flow by email. Always returns a generic success message to avoid leaking account existence. If the email is unverified, the system resends a verification OTP instead of creating a reset token.

200.description: Password reset instructions sent (if account exists)

post.description: Complete password reset using a one-time token delivered via email. The backend derives the user from the token stored in Redis; the client does not send userId.

400.description: Validation error (e.g., weak password or mismatch)

401.description: Invalid or expired reset token, or email not verified
